claim: cot(phi/2) is the BISECTOR partition requirement, not every edge requirement. claim: At a crease, displace the crease point by solving the two offset planes, u = d(n1+n2)/(1+n1.n2) (3x3 with the edge direction for unequal offsets) - never a normalised bisector. Sign-free at reflex corners; the only degeneracy is anti-parallel outward normals (a razor fin, material dihedral -> 0), handled by a mitre limit (SVG default 4). Every corner in greets caps at 2x the height.
